run_doxygen_qbk_generation: run the script to generate QBK documentation files from Doxygen XML for Boost.Geometry R-tree index
run_resolve_executable: run resolve_executable to find and validate the absolute path of a given executable on the system
run_run_command: run run_command to execute a shell command and raise an exception if it fails
run_remove_all_files: run remove_all_files to recursively delete a directory and all its contents with cleanup logging
run_release_build_cleanup: run the script with the --release-build flag to clean up xml and html_by_doxygen directories after generation
